quotes_compared.zh_product_paragraph: Thinking effort（思考投入）、Looped Transformer（循環深度）及Jev式機率判斷已納入必修，分別見[7.23](course/chapters/07.md#7.23)、[14.11](course/chapters/14.md#14.11)與[9.11](course/chapters/09.md#9.11)。C.1–C.5接在第7章後。第19章擴成[三成品路線](course/chapters/19.md#19.13)：既有MoE助理（A）、有限文字Looped解題器（B）、獨立機率判斷服務（C），再接Auto effort；B／C已完成NVIDIA L4訓練與凍結後的最後測試：B兩盒追蹤2928/2956、三數加法2/42；C的核心候選判斷全對，但換說法會出錯。固定下載與命令見[產品操作](docs/lesson-products/README.md)，完整分母、變化測試與限制見[19.20](course/chapters/19.md#19.20)。
quotes_compared.en_product_paragraph: Thinking effort, Looped Transformers, and Jev-style typed probabilistic judgments are now required topics: [7.23](course/chapters/07.md#7.23), [14.11](course/chapters/14.md#14.11), and [9.11](course/chapters/09.md#9.11). C.1–C.5 follows Chapter 7. [Chapter 19](course/chapters/19.md#19.13) has three product routes: the existing MoE assistant (A), a bounded text looped solver (B), and an independent probabilistic decision service (C), followed by Auto effort integration. B/C completed NVIDIA L4 training and a final test after settings were frozen: B solved 2928/2956 two-box tracking records and 2/42 three-number additions; C answered every core candidate judgment correctly but made errors on wording changes. See [product instructions](docs/lesson-products/README.md) for pinned downloads and commands, and [19.20](course/chapters/19.md#19.20) for denominators, shifts and limitations.
